sloka: दिव्यैर्गुणैः शक्रसमो रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।इक्ष्वाकुभ्योऽपि सर्वेभ्यो ह्यतिरिक्तो विशांपते ॥२-२-२८॥
transliteration: divyairguṇaiḥ śakrasamo rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ।ikṣvākubhyo'pi sarvebhyo hyatirikto viśāṁpate ॥2-2-28॥

translations.english: Lord of the people Rama with his divine virtues is equal to Indra. He with his proven valour is exceptional among all the descendents of the Iksvakus.
